Description.SourceString:
Is there a more unwelcoming place on Gielinor, let alone Ashenfall, than the Burning Spire? Life was not meant for this place. It is a cauldron of lava, heated by the Scorched, and sprinkled with KotHaar. The chef, Fuzan, licks his lips and stirs the pot.

It is worth knowing that Fuzan sees the Burning Spire as a great strength. With it in front of him and his volcano, he believes he is unreachable. He cannot conceive of someone navigating the Spire. You know what you must do; take that arrogance and use it against him.
